faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How does the AI sales coach work?
faq.a1: Our AI analyzes your sales conversations in real-time, providing instant feedback based on proven methodologies like SPIN and FAB that are used by top North American sales experts.
faq.q2: Can I customize the AI to my specific sales methodology?
faq.a2: Yes, absolutely. SalesTouch allows you to upload your own sales methodology, frameworks, and best practices. Our AI then adapts to coach based on your unique approach.
faq.q3: What data do I need to provide?
faq.a3: To get the most value from SalesTouch, we recommend sharing your meeting notes, sales transcripts, CRM data, and win/loss analysis. The more data you provide, the more accurate and personalized the AI feedback will be.
faq.q4: How secure is my sales data?
faq.a4: We take data security extremely seriously. All your data is encrypted using AES-256 encryption, stored on SOC 2 Type II certified servers, and is GDPR and CCPA compliant. Your sales data is never shared with third parties without your explicit consent.
